# YAML Test Suite cases the restricted profile is expected to fail (01 test
# plan "Upstream suites", 11 req 18). The runner is TestYAMLTestSuite in
# internal/config/profile (integration tag); the data is test/fixtures/
# yaml-test-suite/data, vendored by scripts/update-test-suites.sh yaml.
#
# Every other case must pass: an "error" case must be rejected, any other
# case must parse without diagnostics to its test.event documents and its
# in.json. A listed case that passes, or a listed ID that is not a case,
# fails the run, so this list only shrinks.
#
# Format: one "<ID> <reason>" per line; # starts a comment. Reasons:
#   profile:anchor       anchors, aliases or merge keys (RZ-CFG-003)
#   profile:tag          a tag other than the YAML 1.2 core tags, or %TAG (RZ-CFG-004)
#   profile:directive    a %YAML version other than 1.2 (RZ-CFG-001)
#   profile:complex-key  a mapping key that is not a scalar (RZ-CFG-001)
#   reviewed:goccy-v1.19.2/<name>
#                        a parser limitation of github.com/goccy/go-yaml
#                        v1.19.2, reviewed; <name> is the case's entry in
#                        the failureTestNames list of goccy's own
#                        yaml_test_suite_test.go at that release. Raising
#                        the goccy version reruns these.
